points: twenty years in marketing. mostly spent watching companies sell themselves stories nobody believes.

mission.pull_quote: a full calendar is not a working strategy.

preferences_and_rules.deliverables: written deliverables only. no calls. no zoom. every engagement starts with a brief and ends with a document you can use.
preferences_and_rules.stack: google antigravity, git worktree isolation, deterministic verifiers. agents work in sandboxes, state stays clean.
preferences_and_rules.voice: direct, concise, the period is a weapon. zero em-dashes, zero padding.
preferences_and_rules.work_style: deep focus, verification gates. if it can't be checked, it doesn't ship.

identity_verification.notice: find me. the same person across the web. if a profile isn't linked here, it isn't me.
